{{Quote|You're upright again, sir. You might try slouching.|Bodyguard to Kosh Teradoc|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' served as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]]. This event occurred during a flashback set in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> he accompanied Teradoc to a [[Unidentified club (Ryvester)|club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryvester]] to meet [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Hachat, who was secretly [[Garik Loran]] of [[Wraith Squadron]] in disguise, to discuss a possible partnership to recover treasure from [[The Palace of Piethet Brighteyes]].<ref name="MK" />

When Teradoc attempted to double cross Hachat by abducting him for [[Interrogation (Imperial Intelligence)|interrogation]], Hachat gave a signal and the other undercover Wraiths, who were working various jobs throughout the club, sprang into action. [[Shalla Nelprin]], posing as a [[Waiter/Legends|server]], approached the table and delivered a kick that broke either the bodyguard's hand or wrist, causing him to drop the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] he was holding. Nelprin then followed with another kick to his jaw, knocking him unconscious in his seat. After the brief skirmish, the Wraiths escaped with [[Mulus Cheems]], a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] specializing in crystalline materials whom Teradoc had brought to analyze a sample of the treasure that Hachat provided.<ref name="MK" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Who's your friend? He looks like a hundred kilos of preserved meat.|Garik Loran on the bodyguard|<ref name="MK" />}}
Kosh Teradoc's bodyguard was a large and heavily built individual. Captain Hachat compared his appearance to "a hundred kilos of preserved meat".<ref name="MK" />
